transcript.text: Back in 2025 I spent a few days in Beijing for work, and I remember chatting with coworkers about where everyone usually stays when they’re in town.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: On that same trip I also hopped from Beijing to Shanghai—nothing dramatic, just the usual commute vibe between those two cities.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My colleague Xu Jing had the hotel under their name—Novotel Beijing Peace—and the check-in date was 2025-04-05, which I only remember because it lined up with a deadline.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: We ended up staying 4 nights there, and honestly it all blurred together after the second day—meetings, late dinners, the whole thing.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And for the flight part, Cao Yun was the passenger on MU5678 with China Eastern, dated 2025-04-20—someone forwarded me the itinerary afterward so I still have those details.
